# ADR-3057: A05: Prefer hardened OS baselines for compute pool 9

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Ad-hoc images drift quickly.

## Decision

Platform teams SHOULD prefer hardened OS baselines for compute pool 9 (A05-9) when provisioning fleets.

## Consequences

Baselines rebuild on a cadence.
